title: Yuuyami to Kataware
description:
“I’m a vampire.” “Give me your blood, mister.”A man about to throw himself off a bridge is suddenly stopped by a vampire girl—one who looks just like any other ordinary high school student. He decides he wouldn’t mind dying if it’s at the hands of such a beautiful girl; however, instead of death, an unexpected bond begins to form between them.From Robico, the beloved creator of My Little Monster a...

تابع أحداث وتطورات Yuuyami to Kataware مع تحديثات يومية وتجربة قراءة فائقة السلاسة وبدقة عالية حصرياً على موقع مانجا تايم (MangaTime).
